text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: There's a special memory that Mejiro McQueen treasures.

text_block_list.name: Young McQueen
text_block_list.text: Wow! The history of the Mejiro family is so wonderful!

text_block_list.name: Young McQueen
text_block_list.text: To think you and Grandfather started it all…

text_block_list.name: Young McQueen
text_block_list.text: Hehe. Someday I'll support the family too!

text_block_list.name: Young McQueen
text_block_list.text: Because I'm going to win the Tenno Sho!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: McQueen's grandmother, the pillar of the Mejiro family, smiles affectionately.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Phew…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: My breath control seems to have improved.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: How was it from your point of view, Trainer?
choice_data_list: You clearly have more stamina now!
You clearly have more stamina now!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: You think so too? Thank goodness.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: I owe it to your unending patience as you work with me, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: I must maintain this form until the Tenno Sho.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After training, I decide to see Mejiro McQueen back to her dorm.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: On the way there…

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Gasp, a wild McQueen appears!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: (It's Gold Ship… If there's anyone here we should be calling wild, it'd be her. You never know what she's going to do next.)

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Ta-da, it's Golgol's home delivery service! Take this!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: What's this?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Oh, this is… a letter from Grandmother?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Hmm, yes, I see…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: My, she and Grandfather? Hehe, they're as happy a couple as ever.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Ah, yes. Why don't we take a stroll and I'll tell you about it?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: There is a large pond in the gardens of the Mejiro family estate.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: I would often walk around its perimeter like this.
choice_data_list: It sounds like you have treasured memories of that time.
It sounds like you have treasured memories of that time.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: …I certainly do.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Every single member of my family is an irreplaceable part of me, and everything I've done with them is a precious memory.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: And that's why…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: I want to win the Tenno Sho, a race the Mejiro family holds dear.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: (The history of the proud Mejiro family…)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: (Everyone who had a hand in writing that history, starting with Grandmother and Grandfather…)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: (I want to show them all…)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: (Victory in the Tenno Sho!)

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The spring Tenno Sho—the race constantly on Mejiro McQueen's mind.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The most important race of her life is fast approaching.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Meanwhile…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Phew… I'm back.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Oh, Ryan!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: You're late. It's almost curfew. I was worried something had happened.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Sorry about that. I just had this thing I needed to finish.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: When the real thing comes, I wanna be sure I'm ready…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: For the spring Tenno Sho.
